description:
Start a broadcast: live transcription and translation of a stream playing now, on a public link listeners open in their own language. Also the tool that creates a broadcast (without a stream: set up ahead, off air).
Use: when the event is live now, or beforehand to get the link to share. A recording that has ended, even a past live stream's file: create_transcription. Reading it while it runs: get_transcription.
Arguments: streamUrl must be live when called; the same streamUrl on the same broadcast reuses its stream. Without streamUrl (and without broadcastId) it only sets up a new broadcast, off air and free: its link can be shared and configured with update_broadcast before the event. broadcastId (from list_broadcasts or get_broadcast) reruns an existing broadcast on its old link, and then name is ignored; without it a new broadcast is made, named name or the stream's host. spokenLanguage is a code like en (omit to detect). spokenTranslations true adds audio of each translation.
List price: $0.60 an hour while it runs, billed per second; Pay as you go bills at least 5 minutes per transcription. Listeners and translations are free.
Transcriptions running at once per account: 5 on Pay as you go, 50 on Premium; past that a start is refused with quota_exceeded.
Behaviour: not idempotent, as annotated: every call with streamUrl starts a new billed run (set up only: free, nothing runs), and without broadcastId makes a new broadcast with a new link. To make a retry safe after a timeout, pass idempotencyKey: the same key and arguments within 24 h return the first run (replayed true) and bill nothing more. VocalStack's servers pull the stream as a visitor who is not signed in; nothing is posted to or changed at the source. Listeners on the link see each line within seconds of it being said, translated into the language they pick, with no account; the text is kept as a transcription. A run lasts until update_broadcast with onAir false or the stream ends, and billing stops at that moment.
Returns: broadcastId, name, link (anyone who opens it reads, or with spokenTranslations also hears, the stream in their language), transcriptionId, state; set up only: broadcastId, name, link, onAir false.
Errors: invalid_state (with link) when already on air, invalid_options for a non-http(s) address or broadcastId without streamUrl, insufficient_credit (with topUpUrl), quota_exceeded, terms_acceptance_required (with acceptUrl for the person to accept the Terms once), not_found for an unknown broadcastId, forbidden for a key without the write and recordings:publish scopes.

broadcastId.description: Optional: run it on this existing broadcast (from list_broadcasts), so its listeners' link stays the same. Omit to make a new broadcast with a new link.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string of visible ASCII. Retrying with the same key and the same arguments within 24 h returns the first result (with replayed true) and nothing is started twice; the same key with other arguments is refused.

name.description: Name of a new broadcast, shown to listeners. Defaults to the stream's host. Ignored with broadcastId.

spokenLanguage.description: Code of the language spoken, e.g. en, es. Omit to detect it.

spokenTranslations.description: Also read each translation aloud, so listeners can hear it in their language as well as read it. Listening stays free.

streamUrl.description: http(s) address of a stream playing now: a YouTube live, an internet radio station, an HLS (.m3u8) or Icecast stream. Omit it (and broadcastId) to only set up a new broadcast and its link ahead of the event, off air and unbilled. A recording that has ended goes to create_transcription instead.

name: start_broadcast
title: Start a broadcast
